description: This PHP source file defines the class 'MapShape' within the 'Aws\Api' namespace. The class represents a map shape in the AWS SDK, providing methods to access key and value shapes for the map, and inherits from a parent class 'Shape'.

classes.name: MapShape
classes.description: Represents a map shape with methods to access key and value shapes, used within AWS SDK shape definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MapShape instance with a definition array and a ShapeMap, setting its type to 'map'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the shape of the map's values, creating it if necessary, or throws an exception if not specified.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the shape of the map's keys, creating it if necessary, defaulting to a string shape.
